tasks.title: Build the skeleton primitive
tasks.description: Create components/ui/skeleton.tsx: one shimmer block, aria-hidden, static when prefers-reduced-motion is set, accepting width/height/rounded props so routes can mirror their layout without inventing variants.

tasks.title: Build the empty-state component
tasks.description: Create components/ui/empty-state.tsx taking a reason and an optional action (label + href or onClick), rendering a heading, explanatory sentence and the action, with consistent spacing across surfaces.

tasks.title: Add the event page loading skeleton
tasks.description: Create app/(public)/events/[slug]/loading.tsx composing the skeleton primitive into the hero, detail column and register panel using the same spacing tokens as the real page.

tasks.title: Add the tickets loading skeleton
tasks.description: Create app/(main)/my-tickets/loading.tsx mirroring the ticket grid and the filter row.

tasks.title: Give the registration dialog a pending state
tasks.description: In register-modal.tsx, disable the submit control while a request is in flight, show progress, and guard against a second submission from a double tap.

tasks.title: Apply registration optimistically
tasks.description: Wrap the registration mutation so the ticket appears in the client cache immediately, is reconciled on success, and is removed on failure without touching the server contract.

tasks.title: Roll back and announce failures
tasks.description: On a rejected registration or cancellation, remove the optimistic entry and announce the server reason through useAnnounce, keeping the dialog open with a retry path.

tasks.title: Add the event route error boundary
tasks.description: Create app/(public)/events/[slug]/error.tsx with recovery copy, a retry that re-mounts the segment, and a working link home; no error message, stack trace, or internal id reaches the user.

tasks.title: Add the tickets route error boundary
tasks.description: Create app/(main)/my-tickets/error.tsx with the same recovery contract, keeping the header and navigation usable.

tasks.title: Wire the empty states
tasks.description: Replace the ad-hoc empty copy in my-tickets, explore results and announcements with the shared component, each naming its cause and offering the relevant action.

tasks.title: Make loading and failure accessible
tasks.description: Mark skeletons aria-hidden, announce the loading state once, and ensure the error boundary and optimistic failure reach the live region.

tasks.title: Verify CLS and the JavaScript budget
tasks.description: Confirm the skeleton and empty-state primitives stay within 5 KB gzip and that the affected routes keep CLS at or below 0.02 in the Lighthouse run.
